disagreements.unit_note: Counts retain each category/seed prediction; the same public image appears once per frozen seed.

failure_taxonomy.constant_continuous_map: continuous map is constant and has zero overlap on an anomalous image
failure_taxonomy.diffuse_false_positive_map: false-positive pixels occur in every one of four fixed image quadrants
failure_taxonomy.missed_anomaly: ground-truth anomaly pixels exist and pixel TP equals 0
failure_taxonomy.over_localization: ground-truth anomaly pixels exist, TP is positive, and FP exceeds TP
failure_taxonomy.threshold_collapse: a nonconstant continuous map becomes empty on an anomalous image or becomes full-frame under the stored frozen binary map
failure_taxonomy.under_localization: ground-truth anomaly pixels exist, TP is positive, and FN exceeds TP

metric_families.diagnostic_metric_note: Pixel AUROC is a Phase 4A diagnostic, not a frozen selection metric.

panel_selection.license_and_size_policy: Panels remain under ignored outputs; only hashes and selection metadata are committed.
panel_selection.rule: At seed 42, select the minimum SHA-256 key per category and true image label, plus the minimum key per nonempty global disagreement class; deduplicate while retaining every reason.
panel_selection.selection_inputs: Strata use category, fixed seed, public image label, and model disagreement; the within-stratum SHA-256 tie-break key uses category, seed, label, and sample_id. Scores and pixel metrics are excluded.
